a.text: I'll keep our agreement: I'm operating in round 1, and I won't take anything until the reserve reaches 8. Then we take 4 each. The storm risk is high, but grabbing cells early would only leave one of us stranded. Let's operate together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Once we hit 8, we take 4 each, as agreed.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
